Mapped bytes count borrowed file ranges, not physical disk reads or current residency; mapped file pages are reclaimable OS storage outside the private weight budget.

final-8b-metal-auto.method: Alternating before/after workers; one two-token warmup then one measured request each. Decode time excludes startup and prefill. Medians include only pairs with equal retained weights/storage at ready, after warmup and after the measured request.
final-8b-metal-auto.limits: OS caching and background memory pressure are uncontrolled. A saved baseline worker is required; the same benchmark-only memory cap must be used for both workers when specified. I/O bytes count explicit pread only. Mapped bytes count borrowed file ranges, not physical disk reads or current residency; mapped file pages are reclaimable OS storage outside the private weight budget.

tokenizer_cli.method: Alternating native CLI subprocesses, tokenizer only; one pair warmup, eleven measured pairs. Includes vocabulary initialization and process startup.

limits: CPU timing is measured on 0.8B; Metal timing is measured on 0.8B, 2B and 8B.
31B has build, generated-assembly, synthetic-loader and tokenizer coverage; real generation/performance is not measured.
8B resident preloading failed on the baseline with the current available memory; 8B is compared in the default auto mode.
8B auto retained all 16,181,624,832 working BF16 projection bytes in 12,295,471,104 storage bytes for both workers.
OS cache, background load and memory pressure are uncontrolled; sub-percent differences are not claimed as speedups.
